 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-hermes-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference-2/play/users/u031/system/state/workspace/programs/task-36453b9a.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # A uniform nonzero divider separates two same-sized masks. Output their overlap.
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        if row[0] != 0 and all(v == row[0] for v in row):
            a, b = grid[:r], grid[r + 1:]
            n = min(len(a), len(b))
            width = min(len(a[0]), len(b[0])) if n else 0
            return [[2 if a[i][j] != 0 and b[i][j] != 0 else 0
                     for j in range(width)] for i in range(n)]
    for c in range(w):
        color = grid[0][c]
        if color != 0 and all(grid[r][c] == color for r in range(h)):
            n = min(c, w - c - 1)
            return [[2 if grid[i][j] != 0 and grid[i][w - n + j] != 0 else 0
                     for j in range(n)] for i in range(h)]
    return [row[:] for row in grid]
"
}
